title: Amp orb: AI-generating status animation
note: Lydia: "Amp orb animation - ai gen animation". The small icon next to a thread in Amp's sidebar while the AI is running (tooltip starts "Orb is run..."). It's a wireframe sphere of 3-4 crossing rings in warm bronze, like a gyroscope. It loops about every 4 seconds: crisp rings, fade to faint, then the rings spin on several axes into a thick jumbled tangle, fade again, and snap back to crisp. Snappy easing, no glow or particles; the energy comes from opacity and the chaotic spin.
